mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.users WHERE email = #{email})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.users (email, password, nickname, status, location_agreed_at) SELECT BTRIM(#{email,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), #{password}, #{nickname}, 'ACTIVE', #{locationAgreedAt} WHERE #{email,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND #{email,jdbcType=VARCHAR} !~ '^[[:space:]]*$'
